title: TestMetadata
description: One test's metadata record (cell × protocol × temperature). Stored as JSON at data/harmonized/tests/{test_id}.json - one file per test.

test_type.description: Coarse category (cycle_aging, hppc, qocv, calendar_aging, drive_cycle, capacity_check) OR a C-rate-aware capacity-check label of the form C{rate}{Discharge|Charge|DischargeCharge} (e.g. C2Discharge for a 2C constant-current discharge, C0p5Discharge for 0.5C). 'qocv' (quasi-OCV) tags low-rate sweeps (C/20 typical) used for OCV / dV-dQ / ICA characterization.

soc_method.description: How soc_range_min/max were determined. celljar persists only facts, never values it computed from the timeseries: 'protocol_asserted' = hardcoded from the source's documented protocol (not verified from data); 'source_published' = the source publishes per-test SOC setpoints in its own metadata. Coulomb-count-derived SOC ranges are intentionally NOT persisted - derive them at query time from coulomb_count_Ah + capacity if needed.

soh_pct.description: Cell state of health at time of test, as % of BOL capacity. See soh_method for how this specific value was computed.

soh_method.description: How soh_pct was computed: 'bol_assumption' = stamped 100% because the test is a single fresh-cell characterization (ORNL, HNEI); 'capacity_vs_first_checkpoint' = CC discharge capacity normalized by the cell's first checkpoint; null when soh_pct itself is null.

cycle_count_at_test.description: Aging cycles elapsed before this test. 0 = BOL (begin of life) / fresh cell characterization.

checkup_id.description: Optional grouping FK: multiple test records that belong to the same source-defined Reference Performance Test (RPT) block share a checkup_id. Currently used by KOLLMEYER 30T_AGING where every ~30 aging cycles the cell undergoes a 5-7 segment characterization block (OCV, C/2, 1C, 2C, HPPC, ...). Null for sources whose tests don't bundle into RPTs.

test_year.description: Year the test was actually run (not the paper publication year). Useful for filtering by data recency and accounting for cell-vintage drift.

source_doi.description: DOI of the paper or dataset that published this test.

source_url.description: Canonical landing page URL for the source dataset.

source_citation.description: Formatted citation for the source test - include in any publication using this data.

source_license.description: SPDX identifier for the test's license (e.g. CC-BY-4.0, ODbL-1.0, MIT, CC0-1.0).

source_license_url.description: URL of the full license text.

n_samples.description: Observed: number of timeseries samples in this test.

duration_s.description: Observed: total elapsed time (seconds) of the test.

sample_dt_min_s.description: Observed: minimum dt between consecutive samples - fastest sampling rate.

sample_dt_median_s.description: Observed: median dt between consecutive samples.

sample_dt_max_s.description: Observed: maximum dt - large values flag sampling gaps.

coulomb_count_observed_min_Ah.description: Observed minimum of the cycler's running signed coulomb count (∫I dt, Ah) over the test. A measurement, not a derivation. SOC range is intentionally NOT persisted - derive it from this + a chosen capacity. Interpretation depends on the source's reset convention: some cyclers reset coulomb count per cycle (so for a multi-cycle cycle_aging test the range is the per-cycle swing, not lifetime throughput), others accumulate.

coulomb_count_observed_max_Ah.description: Observed maximum of the cycler's running signed coulomb count (∫I dt, Ah) over the test. See coulomb_count_observed_min_Ah.
